problem_title: Recurring Provision For Parking — Dr Raj Kumar (2019–2020)
problem_summary: 6 citizen complaints about 'Provision For Parking' were recorded in Dr Raj Kumar between January 2019 and November 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 67% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

agency_attribution_note: 6 of 6 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.

ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Dr Raj Kumar' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Dr Raj Kumar for the period 2019–2020.
